dialogues.jp: 静かに桜が降っている。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossoms flutter in the wind quietly.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossoms flutter in the wind quietly.

dialogues.jp: 窓の外、音もなく静かに。
dialogues.en: There's no sound outside the window.
dialogues.text: There's no sound outside the window.

dialogues.jp: 雪のように。
dialogues.en: Like snowflakes.
dialogues.text: Like snowflakes.

dialogues.jp:
それから俺たちは、本当に他愛もない話を一晩
中続けた。

東の空が白々と明るくなる頃には、さすがに疲
れてしまったのか、さくらは俺のベッドの上で
寝息を立てていた。

仕方なく俺はベッドをさくらに譲って、自分は
床に毛布を敷いて横になった。
dialogues.en: "Are you sleeping yet, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sleeping yet, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp:
傍らのベッドの上ですぅすぅとかわいい寝息を
立てるさくらの横顔を見ていると、なぜか幸せ
な気分になってくる。
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.jp:
そして自分が口にした赤面ものの台詞の数々を
思い出し、無性に恥ずかしくなって毛布を頭か
ら被って悶絶した。
dialogues.en: I shake my head slowly to Sakura as she clings to my back.
dialogues.text: I shake my head slowly to Sakura as she clings to my back.

dialogues.jp:
「あー……なんか一生分の恥ずかしい台詞をま
　とめて言っちまった気分だ……」
dialogues.en: "I was watching cherry blossoms."
dialogues.text: "I was watching cherry blossoms."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "No, the ones outside the window."
dialogues.text: "No, the ones outside the window."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……お兄ちゃん、寝ちゃった？」
dialogues.en: "It's beautiful, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's beautiful, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
うとうとしていると、ベッドの上からさくらの
呼ぶ声が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 「いや」
dialogues.en:
They say blossoms are beautiful because they die and fall,
but even if they don't, they are still beautiful.
dialogues.text:
They say blossoms are beautiful because they die and fall,
but even if they don't, they are still beautiful.

dialogues.jp: 「桜を見ていた」
dialogues.en:
It's sad when the flowering's over. It feels as cruel as
wars you see on TV.
dialogues.text:
It's sad when the flowering's over. It feels as cruel as
wars you see on TV.

dialogues.jp:
花は枯れるから美しいというけれど、枯れなく
てもきれいだ。
dialogues.en:
When it happens to you, you really feel it for the first
time.
dialogues.text:
When it happens to you, you really feel it for the first
time.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクが先生になった理由はね」
dialogues.en: "The reason I became a teacher is..."
dialogues.text: "The reason I became a teacher is..."

dialogues.jp: 唐突な呟きだった。
dialogues.en: That was an unexpected murmur.
dialogues.text: That was an unexpected murmur.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクが子供のころに、イジメられていたから
　なんだ」
dialogues.en: "When I was a child, I was bullied."
dialogues.text: "When I was a child, I was bullied."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん、今思うと他愛ないんだけど、でも、子
　供のいじめって理性じゃないから的確なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, when I think about it now, it was nothing, but when I
was a child, the bullying was too painful for me."
dialogues.text:
"Well, when I think about it now, it was nothing, but when I
was a child, the bullying was too painful for me."

dialogues.jp: 痛み。
dialogues.en: Pain.
dialogues.text: Pain.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「心が｛きし／軋｝むんだ」
dialogues.en: "My heart aches when I think about that."
dialogues.text: "My heart aches when I think about that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「物とか社会的な価値じゃなくて、歴史とか心
　の価値の高いものから壊されていく。そんな
　怖さが……イジメ」
dialogues.en:
"It doesn't damage your belongings or your social value, but
your history and your mental state are damaged first. That's
the terror of bullying."
dialogues.text:
"It doesn't damage your belongings or your social value, but
your history and your mental state are damaged first. That's
the terror of bullying."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「傷は深くて、笑顔が死んで、心が死んで、想
　い出が死んで、ボクの中のボクがいなくなっ
　ていくんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The wound was deep, my smile had gone, my heart was dead,
and all my happy memories had gone... that's how I lost who
I was."
dialogues.text:
"The wound was deep, my smile had gone, my heart was dead,
and all my happy memories had gone... that's how I lost who
I was."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やさしさが死んで……ボクも……人を……」
dialogues.en: "They killed my tenderness... that's why I..."
dialogues.text: "They killed my tenderness... that's why I..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……傷つけた」
dialogues.en: "Hurt..."
dialogues.text: "Hurt..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 呟きは、しかし、答えなかった。
dialogues.en: Sakura doesn't continue.
dialogues.text: Sakura doesn't continue.

dialogues.jp: 声を殺して泣いていたから。
dialogues.en: Because she's silently crying.
dialogues.text: Because she's silently crying.

dialogues.jp: 「……おやすみ」
dialogues.en: "Good night."
dialogues.text: "Good night."

dialogues.jp: 面倒なので追及するのはやめた。
dialogues.en: I feel I'm bothering her, so I stop asking.
dialogues.text: I feel I'm bothering her, so I stop asking.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから……償わなきゃいけないんだと思った」
dialogues.en: "So, I thought I have do something to make up for it."
dialogues.text: "So, I thought I have do something to make up for it."

dialogues.jp: もう、眠ったと思ったころ。
dialogues.en: When I'm half-asleep,
dialogues.text: When I'm half-asleep,

dialogues.jp: 夢うつつ。
dialogues.en: As if in a dream,
dialogues.text: As if in a dream,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、その人にはもう返せないから……未来
　に」
dialogues.en:
"But I can't make it up to that person anymore, so, for the
future..."
dialogues.text:
"But I can't make it up to that person anymore, so, for the
future..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「これから生まれる、ボクみたいな子に返そう
　と思うんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I want to make it up to the children who're coming into
this life from now on."
dialogues.text:
"I want to make it up to the children who're coming into
this life from now on."

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・寝物語◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei's pillow talk◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei's pillow talk◆

dialogues.jp:
一緒にベッドで眠りながら、夢うつつ、さくら
の呟きを聞く。
dialogues.en: Sleeping in bed together, I listened to Sakura in a dream.
dialogues.text: Sleeping in bed together, I listened to Sakura in a dream.

dialogues.jp:
悲しそうに、なにかが過去にあって、さくらは
その罪滅ぼしに講師になったという。
dialogues.en:
Sakura said she became a teacher to make up for a mistake
she made in the past.
dialogues.text:
Sakura said she became a teacher to make up for a mistake
she made in the past.

dialogues.jp:
また、自分のようないじめられっ子を助けてあ
げたいと――その夜に語った。
dialogues.en:
And she wants to help those children suffering from bullying
like she experienced -- that's what she told me that night.
dialogues.text:
And she wants to help those children suffering from bullying
like she experienced -- that's what she told me that night.
